title: OutreachRequest
description: apps_lic LinkedIn recruiter outreach draft request schema. Schema version: apps_lic_outreach_v1. Live path drafts only; managed research delegation is deprecated.

recipient_id.description: Unique identifier for the recipient (person or role).

target_role_id.description: Target role identifier (empty string for exploratory outreach).

application_status.description: Sender's application status relative to the target role.

preloaded_context_manifest_path.description: Path to a pre-built PreloadedOutreachContextManifest (optional; triggers R4 path when present and fresh).

send_mode.description: Allowed send modes. Forbidden values (send_now, auto_send, connector_send) are rejected at U0 with exit_code=2.

omission_policy.description: Policy for handling unsupported personalization claims. omit_unsupported: omit claim, track in OutreachDraft.omitted_claims. hitl_required: escalate to HITL. fail_closed: block draft.

personalization_claims.description: Optional list of specific personalization claims to include. Each must be grounded in source_items.

briefing_only.description: Deprecated for apps_lic. Briefing-only and managed research requests fail closed instead of delegating to another app.
